t: This Act except as otherwise provided herein shall become effective on July 1, 1948.

fable.w: This section only sets the effective date of the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government, so there is no tempting reading that suggests participation.
fable.s: This Act except as otherwise provided herein shall become effective on July 1, 1948.

opus.w: This section only sets the date the Act takes effect. It does not involve anyone outside the federal government in a federal decision. There is no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, so nothing here could reasonably be read as participation.

qwen_chat.w: The section solely establishes the effective date of the Act. It does not mandate or recommend any consultation, coordination, public hearing, or advisory process involving parties outside the federal government.
